# Col'Cacchio Menu Dashboard

> Internal dashboard for browsing Col'Cacchio store menus, prices, promotions, reviews, and Uber Eats coverage across all South African locations.

## Pages

- [Overview](/): KPI summary across all stores, items, and recent activity.
- [Stores](/stores): Browse and search every Col'Cacchio store.
- [Stores Overview](/stores-overview): Tabular comparison of all stores.
- [Menu Browser](/menu): Filter menu items by store, category, and price.
- [Item Comparison](/compare): Compare the same item across multiple stores.
- [Categories & Pricing](/analytics): Pricing analytics by category and store.
- [Promotions](/promotions): Active promotions, mechanics, and rationales.
- [Reviews](/reviews): Google Maps reviews, sentiment, and AI insights.
- [Uber Eats](/uber-eats): Uber Eats coverage and per-item links.

## Optional

- [Data Upload](/upload): Internal — Excel-based menu refresh.
- [Activity Log](/activity): Internal — audit trail of dashboard activity.
- [Sign in](/auth): Authentication.
